summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Phase 3: House Style Profiles v1. All 21 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend UI features working correctly including Style Profiles page, PageWorkspace style profile integration, and navigation.
passed_tests: GET /api/style-profiles - returns all profiles with defaults_by_family mapping
GET /api/style-profiles?family=Core Hub - filters by family
GET /api/style-profiles?status=active - filters by status
GET /api/style-profiles/family/{family} - returns active profiles for a family with default_profile
GET /api/style-profiles/family/Trust - returns Trust First as default
GET /api/style-profiles/family/NonExistent - returns empty list
GET /api/style-profiles/{id} - returns single profile with tonal_controls, include/avoid language
GET /api/style-profiles/nonexistent - returns 404
POST /api/style-profiles - creates profile with tonal_controls, include/avoid language, page_families, is_default
PUT /api/style-profiles/{id} - updates profile fields including tonal_controls
PUT /api/style-profiles/{id} - updates include/avoid language
DELETE /api/style-profiles/{id} - deletes profile
DELETE /api/style-profiles/nonexistent - returns 404
POST /api/style-profiles/{id}/set-default - sets as default for its families (unsets others)
POST /api/style-profiles/{id}/toggle-status - toggles active/inactive
POST /api/style-profiles/seed - skips if profiles already exist
Seeded profile integrity: Brand Welcome (Core Hub, warmth=9, formality=4)
Seeded profile integrity: Warm Guidance (Guided Path, Category Support)
All 6 seeded profiles verified: Brand Welcome, Warm Guidance, Trust First, Quiet Luxury, Sensual-Professional, Grounded Education
POST /api/pages/{page_id}/generate accepts use_style_profile and style_profile_id fields
Style Profiles page loads at /styles route
Navigation sidebar shows Styles link with Palette icon
Family summary grid shows 8 family cards with counts and sparkle indicators for defaults
Profile cards display with expand/collapse working
Profile expanded view shows Description, Tonal Controls (purple bars), Emphasize/Avoid language tags
Profile action buttons: Edit, Deactivate, Delete, Set Default
Family filter click and clear working
Profile edit mode with all form fields (name, description, tonal sliders, include/avoid, families)
Profile edit Save/Cancel buttons working
Create profile form with all fields including 6 tonal sliders
Create profile family assignment buttons working
Create profile default checkbox present
PageWorkspace: Style toggle section shows when family has default profile
PageWorkspace: Style toggle checkbox ON by default
PageWorkspace: Style name displayed (Brand Welcome for Core Hub)
PageWorkspace: Active Style indicator in sidebar with profile name and description
PageWorkspace: 'Manage styles' link in Active Style indicator
Refresh profiles button working
seed_data_creation: 6 seeded style profiles exist: Brand Welcome (Core Hub), Warm Guidance (Guided Path, Category Support), Trust First (Trust), Quiet Luxury (District), Sensual-Professional (Conversion), Grounded Education (FAQ/Support, Media/Asset). All are set as defaults for their families.
